question: Which tag creates a hyperlink?
explanation: The <a> (anchor) tag creates a hyperlink. Its href attribute sets where the link goes.

question: Which tag inserts an image?
explanation: embeds an image. It needs a src attribute for the file and an alt attribute for accessibility.

question: Which tag creates a bulleted (unordered) list?
explanation: <ul> creates an unordered list with bullets. <ol> creates a numbered list, and <li> is each list item.

question: Which tag inserts a line break?
explanation: is an empty element that moves the following content to a new line.

question: Where is the text of the <title> element shown?
options: At the top of the page body
explanation: The <title> inside <head> appears in the browser tab and is also used by search engines and bookmarks.

question: Which attribute sets the destination URL of a link?
explanation: href (hypertext reference) holds the URL that an <a> tag points to.

question: Which tag marks text as having strong importance?
explanation: <strong> adds meaning (strong importance) and is bold by default. <b> is only visual bold with no extra meaning.

question: Which attribute makes a form field mandatory before submitting?
explanation: The required attribute stops the form from submitting until the field has a value.

question: What does the for attribute on a <label> do?
options: Sets the font of the label
Links the label to the input with the same id
explanation: for connects the label to an input id. Clicking the label focuses the input, and screen readers read them together.

question: Which element should wrap the main content of a page and appear only once?
explanation: <main> holds the unique main content of the page. There should be only one visible <main> per page.

question: Which input type shows a date picker in modern browsers?
explanation: <input type="date"> shows a native date picker and stores the value as YYYY-MM-DD.

question: What does <!DOCTYPE html> do?
options: Tells the browser to render the page in standards mode
explanation: The doctype tells the browser to use modern standards mode instead of the old quirks mode.

question: Which tag defines a header cell in a table?
explanation: <th> is a table header cell. It is bold and centered by default and helps screen readers understand the table.

question: What does target="_blank" do on a link?
options: Opens the link in a new tab or window
explanation: target="_blank" opens the link in a new browsing context, usually a new tab.

question: Which meta tag is needed for a page to scale correctly on mobile?
explanation: The viewport meta tag sets the page width to the device width, so responsive CSS works on phones.

question: What is true about <script async>?
options: It runs after the whole document is parsed, in order
It downloads in parallel and runs as soon as it is ready, possibly out of order
It always runs last after all other scripts
It only runs after a user interaction
explanation: async scripts run as soon as they finish downloading, so their order is not guaranteed. defer keeps order and waits for parsing.

question: Which attribute delays loading images that are off screen?
explanation: loading="lazy" on or

question: What does an empty alt attribute (alt="") on an image mean?
options: It is an error and must be avoided
The image is decorative, so screen readers skip it
The image is hidden from the page
explanation: An empty alt marks a decorative image. Screen readers ignore it, which is better than reading a file name.

question: Which element lets you provide different image sources for different screen sizes or formats?
explanation: holds several elements with media or type conditions, plus an fallback.

question: What does rel="noopener" do on a link with target="_blank"?
options: Prevents the new page from accessing window.opener
Removes the link from search results
explanation: noopener stops the opened page from controlling the original page through window.opener, which improves security.

question: Which attribute gives an accessible name to a button that only shows an icon?
explanation: aria-label provides text that screen readers announce when the button has no visible text.

question: Which is a valid custom data attribute?
explanation: Custom data attributes must start with data-. In JavaScript you read it with element.dataset.userId.

question: What does a <button> inside a <form> do when it has no type attribute?
options: It acts as type="submit" and submits the form
It acts as type="reset" and clears the form
explanation: The default type of a button is submit. Add type="button" when the button should not submit the form.
